audience: community managers who answer members on a Discourse forum

useCases.title: Search the forum and read matching topics
useCases.text: Search topics, posts, users and categories for a term. Open a matching topic to read its title, category and first posts.

useCases.title: Catch up on the latest and top topics
useCases.text: List the latest topics, or the top topics for a period. Read one post with its raw Markdown to see the exact wording.

useCases.title: Reply to a topic
useCases.text: Read a topic, then post a reply in it as the key owner. The reply is published on the forum when you post it, so check the text first.

useCases.title: Start a new topic in a category
useCases.text: List the categories and tags, then create a public topic in one category. The topic is published on the forum when it is created.

useCases.title: Review notifications and private messages
useCases.text: List the notifications and the private messages a user received. Mark the notifications as read when you are done.
